title: APM · Application
description: One application in depth: golden signals, endpoints, dependencies, databases, runtime, instances, traces and logs.

options.content: **Web application** = answers HTTP requests, so Throughput, latency, endpoints and status are filled in.  **Worker** (queue / job consumer) = no HTTP requests: those panels stay empty; use *Calls out*, *Dependencies*, *Database / cache calls* and *Runtime* below.

panels.title: Throughput
panels.description: Requests per second handled by the selected instances / endpoints.

panels.title: Error rate
panels.description: Share of requests that failed (HTTP 5xx or exception).

panels.title: Avg latency
panels.description: Average request duration.

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95% of requests are faster than this.

panels.title: Calls out / sec
panels.description: Outgoing calls per second (databases, cache, HTTP) by the selected instances.

panels.title: Instances reporting
panels.description: Pods of this application that currently send traces or runtime metrics.

panels.title: Calls to other services and databases
panels.description: Every service or database this application calls (from the service graph). Type 'database' = a database or cache node.

targets.expr: (100 * sum by (server, connection_type) (rate(traces_service_graph_request_failed_total{client="$application"}[$__range])) / sum by (server, connection_type) (rate(traces_service_graph_request_total{client="$application"}[$__range]))) or (0 * sum by (server, connection_type) (rate(traces_service_graph_request_total{client="$application"}[$__range])))

sum by (server, connection_type) (rate(traces_service_graph_request_client_seconds_sum{client="$application"}[$__range])) / sum by (server, connection_type) (rate(traces_service_graph_request_client_seconds_count{client="$application"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Called by
panels.description: Who calls this application. 'user' = traffic from outside the instrumented services (browser, ingress, other systems).

targets.expr: (100 * sum by (client, connection_type) (rate(traces_service_graph_request_failed_total{server="$application"}[$__range])) / sum by (client, connection_type) (rate(traces_service_graph_request_total{server="$application"}[$__range]))) or (0 * sum by (client, connection_type) (rate(traces_service_graph_request_total{server="$application"}[$__range])))

sum by (client, connection_type) (rate(traces_service_graph_request_server_seconds_sum{server="$application"}[$__range])) / sum by (client, connection_type) (rate(traces_service_graph_request_server_seconds_count{server="$application"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Database / cache calls / sec
panels.description: Calls to databases and caches by type (mariadb, redis, mongodb ...).

defaults.noValue: No database or cache calls in this range

panels.title: Database / cache p95 latency
panels.description: 95th percentile call duration per database type.

defaults.noValue: No database or cache calls in this range

panels.title: Database / cache error rate
panels.description: Failed database calls.

targets.expr: (100 * sum by (db_system) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="$application",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_CLIENT",k8s_pod_name=~"$instance",db_system!="",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (db_system) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="$application",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_CLIENT",k8s_pod_name=~"$instance",db_system!=""}[$__rate_interval]))) or (0 * sum by (db_system) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="$application",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_CLIENT",k8s_pod_name=~"$instance",db_system!=""}[$__rate_interval])))

defaults.noValue: No database or cache calls in this range

panels.title: Slowest database / cache operations
panels.description: Operations grouped by type and operation name, ordered by the share of time spent in them.

targets.expr: sum by (db_system, span_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_sum{service_name="$application",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_CLIENT",k8s_pod_name=~"$instance",db_system!=""}[$__range])) / sum by (db_system, span_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_count{service_name="$application",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_CLIENT",k8s_pod_name=~"$instance",db_system!=""}[$__range]))

100 * sum by (db_system, span_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_sum{service_name="$application",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_CLIENT",k8s_pod_name=~"$instance",db_system!=""}[$__range])) / scalar(sum(sum by (db_system, span_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_sum{service_name="$application",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_CLIENT",k8s_pod_name=~"$instance",db_system!=""}[$__range]))))

panels.title: External HTTP calls
panels.description: Outgoing HTTP calls grouped by target host (other services, third-party APIs).

targets.expr: (100 * sum by (server_address) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="$application",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_CLIENT",k8s_pod_name=~"$instance",db_system="",server_address!="",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[$__range])) / sum by (server_address) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="$application",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_CLIENT",k8s_pod_name=~"$instance",db_system="",server_address!=""}[$__range]))) or (0 * sum by (server_address) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="$application",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_CLIENT",k8s_pod_name=~"$instance",db_system="",server_address!=""}[$__range])))

panels.title: Event loop utilization
panels.description: Share of time the event loop is busy. Close to 100% = the process is CPU-bound and requests queue up.

panels.title: Event loop delay p99
panels.description: How late the event loop runs its callbacks. High values = blocked main thread.

panels.title: Heap used
panels.description: V8 heap in use per pod. A steady climb = memory leak.

panels.title: Garbage collection time
panels.description: Seconds per second spent in GC pauses.

panels.title: Pod CPU (cores)
panels.description: CPU used by the pods of this application (cAdvisor; needs the kubernetes integration).

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!="", container!="POD"}[$__rate_interval])) and on (namespace, pod) fyno:workload_pod:owner{workload="$application", pod=~"$instance"}

defaults.noValue: No data (needs the kubernetes integration with cluster access)

panels.title: Pod memory (working set)
panels.description: Memory used by the pods of this application (cAdvisor; needs the kubernetes integration).

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="", container!="POD"}) and on (namespace, pod) fyno:workload_pod:owner{workload="$application", pod=~"$instance"}

defaults.noValue: No data (needs the kubernetes integration with cluster access)

panels.title: Instances
panels.description: One row per pod of this application. A dash (–) means no HTTP requests (worker or idle).

targets.expr: (100 * sum by (k8s_pod_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="$application",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",k8s_pod_name=~"$instance",http_route=~"$endpoint",http_response_status_code=~"$status",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[$__range])) / sum by (k8s_pod_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="$application",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",k8s_pod_name=~"$instance",http_route=~"$endpoint",http_response_status_code=~"$status"}[$__range]))) or (0 * sum by (k8s_pod_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="$application",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",k8s_pod_name=~"$instance",http_route=~"$endpoint",http_response_status_code=~"$status"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Throughput by status class
panels.description: Requests per second split into 2xx / 3xx / 4xx / 5xx.

defaults.noValue: No HTTP requests in this range

panels.title: Latency percentiles
panels.description: Request duration percentiles over time.

defaults.noValue: No HTTP requests in this range

panels.title: Error rate
panels.description: Percentage of failed requests over time.

panels.title: p95 latency by instance
panels.description: 95th percentile per pod. A single slow pod points to a node or pod problem.

defaults.noValue: No HTTP requests in this range

panels.title: Throughput by instance
panels.description: Load balance between pods.

defaults.noValue: No HTTP requests in this range

panels.title: Request duration heatmap (click a dot to open its trace)
panels.description: Each cell is a latency bucket. Dots are sample requests: click one to open its trace in Tempo.

panels.title: Endpoints (selected range) — click an endpoint to list its traces
panels.description: Per endpoint: traffic, errors, latency, and the share of total time the application spends in it (find what to optimise first).

targets.expr: (100 * sum by (http_request_method, http_route) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="$application",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",k8s_pod_name=~"$instance",http_route=~"$endpoint",http_response_status_code=~"$status",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[$__range])) / sum by (http_request_method, http_route) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="$application",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",k8s_pod_name=~"$instance",http_route=~"$endpoint",http_response_status_code=~"$status"}[$__range]))) or (0 * sum by (http_request_method, http_route) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="$application",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",k8s_pod_name=~"$instance",http_route=~"$endpoint",http_response_status_code=~"$status"}[$__range])))

sum by (http_request_method, http_route) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_sum{service_name="$application",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",k8s_pod_name=~"$instance",http_route=~"$endpoint",http_response_status_code=~"$status"}[$__range])) / sum by (http_request_method, http_route) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_count{service_name="$application",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",k8s_pod_name=~"$instance",http_route=~"$endpoint",http_response_status_code=~"$status"}[$__range]))

100 * sum by (http_request_method, http_route) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_sum{service_name="$application",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",k8s_pod_name=~"$instance",http_route=~"$endpoint",http_response_status_code=~"$status"}[$__range])) / scalar(sum(sum by (http_request_method, http_route) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_sum{service_name="$application",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",k8s_pod_name=~"$instance",http_route=~"$endpoint",http_response_status_code=~"$status"}[$__range]))))

panels.title: Requests / sec by endpoint (top 10)
panels.description: Busiest endpoints.

defaults.noValue: No HTTP requests in this range

panels.title: p95 latency by endpoint (top 10)
panels.description: Slowest endpoints.

defaults.noValue: No HTTP requests in this range

panels.title: Errors / sec by endpoint
panels.description: Failing endpoints. Empty is good.

defaults.noValue: No HTTP requests in this range

panels.title: Traces and logs  (click a Trace ID to open it in the Trace explorer)
Recent error traces
panels.description: Latest traces of this application that contain an error.

panels.title: Slow traces
panels.description: Latest traces of this application slower than the threshold chosen at the top.

panels.title: Application logs
panels.description: Logs of the selected pods. Lines that carry a trace_id get a TraceID link that opens the trace.
